title: اختبار تدريبي على اختبار شهر نوفمبر - Math - الصف الثاني الإعدادي لغات
scope: Algebra (Unit 2): from Factorizing by Taking out the GCF to Factorizing by Grouping. Geometry (Unit 3): Congruence, Pythagoras' Theorem and its Converse.
source: Scope from the Math supervisor's «تحديد شهر نوفمبر» (2026-11-24). Questions follow the Student's Book 2026/2027 and the ministry «كتاب الأداءات والتقييمات» (Math), term 1.

questions.explanation: Divide each term by the common factor 5x: 5x² ÷ 5x = x and 15xy ÷ 5x = 3y, so 5x² + 15xy = 5x(x + 3y).
questions.lesson: Factorizing by Taking out the GCF

questions.text: The greatest common factor of 12x³ + 6x² is ......
questions.explanation: The GCF of 12 and 6 is 6, and the lower power of x is x², so the GCF is 6x²: 12x³ + 6x² = 6x²(2x + 1).
questions.lesson: Factorizing by Taking out the GCF

questions.text: The solution set of the equation 5y² − 25y = 0 in R is ......
questions.explanation: 5y(y − 5) = 0, so 5y = 0 or y − 5 = 0, which gives y = 0 or y = 5.
questions.lesson: Factorizing by Taking out the GCF

questions.text: If 2a + b = 6 and 3a + b = 8, then 3a(2a + b) + b(2a + b) = ......
questions.explanation: Take out the common factor (2a + b): 3a(2a + b) + b(2a + b) = (2a + b)(3a + b) = 6 × 8 = 48.
questions.lesson: Factorizing by Taking out the GCF

questions.text: x² + 7x + 12 factorizes as ......
questions.explanation: Look for two numbers whose product is 12 and whose sum is 7: 3 and 4, so x² + 7x + 12 = (x + 3)(x + 4).

questions.text: x² − 3x − 28 factorizes as ......
questions.explanation: Two numbers with product −28 and sum −3: −7 and 4. The larger one takes the sign of the middle term.

questions.text: If (x + a)(y + b) = xy + 5x + 7y + 35, then ab = ......
questions.explanation: Expanding: (x + a)(y + b) = xy + bx + ay + ab, so b = 5, a = 7 and ab = 35.

questions.text: If (x − 5) is one factor of 2x² − 7x − 15, the other factor is ......
The solution set of x² + 14x − 32 = 0 in R is ......
If 9x² + bx + 1 is a perfect square, the positive value of b is ......
questions.explanation: The middle term of a perfect square = 2 × √(first term) × √(last term): 2 × 3x × 1 = 6x, so b = 6.

questions.text: If kx² + 20x + 25 is a perfect square, then k = ......
questions.explanation: 20x = 2 × 2x × 5, so the first term is (2x)² = 4x² and k = 4.

questions.text: 4x² − 25 factorizes as ......
questions.explanation: A difference of two squares: (2x)² − 5² = (2x − 5)(2x + 5).

questions.text: x³ + 125 factorizes as ......
questions.explanation: A sum of two cubes: x³ + 5³ = (x + 5)(x² − 5x + 25). The middle sign in the second bracket is opposite to the first.

questions.text: If a + b = 5 and a² − b² = 15, then a − b = ......
questions.explanation: a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b), so 15 = (a − b) × 5 and a − b = 3.

questions.text: Using factorization, the value of (98)² − 4 is ......
x³ + 6x² − 4x − 24 factorizes completely as ......
ax + ay + bx + by factorizes as ......
questions.explanation: a(x + y) + b(x + y) = (x + y)(a + b).

questions.text: To factorize x⁴ + 4 by completing the square, we add and subtract ......
questions.explanation: x⁴ + 4x² + 4 − 4x² = (x² + 2)² − (2x)², which is a difference of two squares.

questions.text: Which of the following is NOT enough for two triangles to be congruent?
choices: The three pairs of corresponding angles are congruent
Two sides and the included angle are congruent
The three pairs of corresponding sides are congruent
In two right triangles, the hypotenuse and one leg are congruent
questions.explanation: Two triangles can have equal angles while one is bigger than the other, so angles alone are not enough.

questions.text: If Δ ABC ≅ Δ XYZ, AB = (2x + 1) cm and XY = 9 cm, then x = ......
questions.explanation: Corresponding sides of congruent triangles are equal: 2x + 1 = 9, so x = 4.

questions.text: In the figure, AC ∩ DB = {H}, HA = HD and m(∠A) = m(∠D). The triangles AHB and DHC are congruent by ......
choices: two sides and the included angle (SAS)
two angles and the included side (ASA)
questions.explanation: ∠A ≅ ∠D (given), HA = HD (given) and ∠AHB ≅ ∠DHC (vertically opposite), so the triangles are congruent by ASA.

questions.text: In the figure, Δ ABC ≅ Δ ABD, AC = 7 cm and BD = 5 cm. The perimeter of ADBC is ......
questions.explanation: From the congruence AD = AC = 7 cm and BC = BD = 5 cm, so the perimeter is 7 + 7 + 5 + 5 = 24 cm.

questions.text: If Δ ABC ≅ Δ DEF, m(∠A) = 50° and m(∠E) = 70°, then m(∠F) = ......
questions.explanation: Corresponding angles of congruent triangles are equal: m(∠D) = m(∠A) = 50°. The angles of triangle DEF add up to 180°: m(∠F) = 180° − (50° + 70°) = 60°.

questions.text: In the two right-angled triangles ABC and XYZ, m(∠B) = m(∠Y) = 90°, AC = XZ and AB = XY. The two triangles are congruent by ......
choices: two angles and the included side (ASA)
two sides and the included angle (SAS)
questions.explanation: AC and XZ are the hypotenuses and AB and XY are legs, so the right triangles are congruent by the hypotenuse and a leg (RHS). It is not SAS, because the right angle is not between AC and AB.

questions.text: Which of the following could be the side lengths of a right-angled triangle?
questions.explanation: 15² = 225 and 9² + 12² = 81 + 144 = 225: the square of the longest side equals the sum of the squares of the other two.

questions.text: A triangle with sides 12 cm, 10 cm and 7 cm is ......
questions.explanation: The longest side squared is 12² = 144, the other two give 10² + 7² = 149, and 144 < 149, so the triangle is acute-angled.

questions.text: In the figure, triangle ABC is right-angled at C, AC = 7 cm and CB = 24 cm. Then x = ......
questions.explanation: By Pythagoras' theorem: x² = 7² + 24² = 49 + 576 = 625, so x = 25 cm.

questions.text: Which of the following could be the side lengths of an obtuse-angled triangle?
questions.explanation: 6² = 36 and 3² + 5² = 34, and 36 > 34, so the angle opposite the longest side is obtuse. 8, 15, 17 make a right triangle.

questions.text: A rectangular swimming pool is 40 m long and 30 m wide. Mariam swims along its diagonal. The distance she swims is ......
questions.explanation: The diagonal is the hypotenuse of a right triangle with legs 40 m and 30 m: 40² + 30² = 1600 + 900 = 2500, so the diagonal is 50 m.

questions.text: A triangle with sides 40 cm, 9 cm and 41 cm is ......
questions.explanation: 41² = 1681 and 40² + 9² = 1600 + 81 = 1681. The square of the longest side equals the sum of the squares of the other two, so by the converse of Pythagoras' theorem the triangle is right-angled.
